name: 물안개 계곡
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production UI icon for a tiny cozy witch potion-shop game. ONE isolated complete object/emblem centered on REAL transparent alpha background, generous padding. Front orthographic or gentle front three-quarter view. Strict chunky hard-square pixel art, dark plum #432039 stepped outline, warm antique gold #efc77c, ivory highlights, muted violet/sage accents, 4 flat clustered shades, readable at logical 32x40 pixels. No text, letters, digits, watermark, glow, blur, gradients, cast shadow, floor or background scene. Subject: two compact dark violet cliffs framing a short turquoise waterfall and pale silver curling river; one unified terrain badge, absolutely no background rectangle or mist halo.
